claims.statement: The Data Act applies since 12 September 2025 and creates user access and third-party sharing rights for raw and pre-processed connected-product data that is readily available to the data holder.

The gateway cannot rely on the Data Act as an independent telemetry right: roles and access must be grounded in the OEM/data-holder relationship and a valid legal basis remains necessary for personal data.
Qualifying micro and small manufacturers are generally exempt from the Chapter II obligations, so the original small-OEM segment is materially narrower than stated at discovery.

Trade-secret, health, safety and security protections can justify safeguards, suspension or refusal in specified circumstances, which prevents a fully automatic entitlement engine from safely resolving every request.

Commission model terms cover data-holder-to-user, user-to-recipient and data-holder-to-recipient relationships, showing that the essential contract is obtainable in principle but not eliminating OEM negotiation.

Steelbridge already sells consent, authorization, APIs, audit and white-label deployment for this exact regulatory use case at EUR 250, EUR 500 and EUR 750 per month plus optional EUR 1500 onboarding.
dDruid and Servitly demonstrate that incumbent IoT and after-sales platforms can bundle the compliance layer because they already manage telemetry, customer roles and service workflows.
The defensible wedge, if any, is a vertical OEM integration with contract-permitted schema and adjudication reuse; generic request intake and identity verification are not differentiated.
No source establishes request volume, OEM conversion, willingness to pay, partner-sourced acquisition, gross margin, retention or enterprise payback for this candidate.
No source establishes that cross-OEM schema, identity or adjudication data may be retained and reused under customer confidentiality, GDPR and trade-secret constraints.

contrary_evidence: A direct specialist already offers the same compliance layer, white labelling and public price tiers.
Qualifying micro and small manufacturers are generally exempt from the relevant Data Act obligations.
Broader IoT and servitization platforms already advertise native Data Act capabilities at the telemetry layer.
Generic privacy-rights software already automates intake, identity verification, retrieval and secure response.
Trade-secret, safety and personal-data constraints require case-specific controls and sometimes human review.
